---
title: "MCD: Medicare Consumer Directory"
description: "Demographic information about persons who have registered for a Medicare number with Services Australia."
---

Demographic information about persons who have registered for a Medicare number with Services Australia.

*Defines the Medicare Consumer Directory population as people with active Medicare enrolment.*
